documentation.subject: ${SERVICE_NAME}: readiness stopped answering from outside
documentation.content:
The external probe of `/v1/health/ready` has been failing for ten minutes. This is the outside view: it fires whether the API answered 503, timed out, or never accepted the connection at all — including when no instance is running.

Runbook: `docs/ops/deployment-runbooks.md`, "Readiness is failing".

First three commands:

    curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n' "$(gcloud run services describe ${SERVICE_NAME} --region europe-west3 --format='value(status.url)')/v1/health/ready"
    gcloud run services describe ${SERVICE_NAME} --region europe-west3 --format='yaml(status.conditions,status.latestReadyRevisionName)'
    gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="${SERVICE_NAME}"' --freshness 30m --limit 30 --order desc --format='value(timestamp,jsonPayload.event,jsonPayload.message,textPayload)'

Stop conditions:

- On `dev`, a cold start after a long idle period can exceed the probe timeout once. One failed probe is not this alert; ten minutes of them is.
- If the service reports `Ready: True` and the probe still fails, the fault is between the probe and the service — check the provider status page before touching the release.

conditions.displayName: Uptime check failing for ten minutes
